summary.short_summary: Ameer Hashish leads a scalable audience-sharing platform that has generated $1.7 million in revenue over 10 months with only two part-time freelancers. The company charges advertisers an average fee of 8.5% of their ad spend, requiring at least an 18% D7 ROAS. Revenue diversification is evident, with no single client exceeding 11% of net revenue, and approximately 70% of contracts are fixed-term, providing predictable income. Client acquisition relies on a referral-based model, with Ameer personally managing sales. The company holds a provisional patent on its audience-building methods and aggregates 3,000 distinct audiences. Ameer aims to scale revenue from $280k to $2 million monthly within 18 months while exploring new verticals and seeking investment, valuing the company at roughly $8 million.
